name: Transient Congenital Hypothyroidism Due to Neonatal Factor

ethnicAssociations: Higher incidence reported in Asian populations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Neonatal Screening and Confirmatory Testing Criteria for Transient Congenital Hypothyroidism

criteria.description: Elevated thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) levels detected on neonatal screening
Normalization of thyroid hormone levels (TSH and free T4) within 3-6 months without treatment
Absence of permanent thyroid gland abnormalities on imaging (ultrasound or scintigraphy)
Presence of neonatal factors such as prematurity, maternal iodine exposure, or maternal antithyroid drug use

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Elevated neonatal TSH with subsequent normalization of thyroid function tests within 6 months and absence of permanent thyroid gland abnormalities on imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires careful follow-up to distinguish from permanent congenital hypothyroidism.

pathognomonic.notes: Common early sign in neonatal hypothyroidism
Reduced muscle tone observed in affected infants

searchTerms: poor sucking or swallowing in neonates

common.notes: Enlarged tongue contributing to feeding issues
Common physical finding in hypothyroid infants

rare.notes: Facial puffiness due to mucopolysaccharide deposition

laboratory: Normal or low free T4 during transient hypothyroid phase
Normalization of thyroid function tests within 3-6 months
imaging: Normal thyroid gland size and location on ultrasound
Absence of thyroid dysgenesis or ectopy on scintigraphy
genetic: No known permanent genetic mutations associated; transient condition linked to neonatal factors
other: History of maternal iodine exposure or antithyroid drug use
Prematurity or neonatal illness as contributing factors

distinguishingFeatures: Thyroid dysgenesis or agenesis on imaging
Low or normal TSH with low free T4
May have other pituitary hormone deficiencies

redFlags: Failure to normalize thyroid function within 6 months
Presence of thyroid dysgenesis on imaging
references: American Academy of Pediatrics. Clinical Practice Guideline: Screening and Management of Congenital Hypothyroidism. Pediatrics. 2014.
Orphanet: Transient congenital hypothyroidism due to neonatal factor. ORPHA:238699.
Lazar L, et al. Transient congenital hypothyroidism: etiology and outcome. Horm Res Paediatr. 2017.
